Summary:
- Mid-size financial research shop (investment research + analyst portal). Heavy PDF and historic data ingestion (10+ years).
- Primary ask: replace Elastic+custom ranking with RAG + vector index + reranking; dedicated capacity preferred for performance isolation & auditability.
- Data residency non-negotiable: primary corpus must stay in NA region; metadata/search logs retained per policy. KMS/HSM required for key management.
Requirements / goals:
- Index scale target: initial 30M embeddings (growing to 120M over 18 months).
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 180ms for top-k retrieval; end-to-end reranking p99 target < 300ms for synchronous web search.
- Throughput: baseline 250 qps sustained for portal peak, burstable to 1k qps for earnings season.
- Cost target: <$0.005 per query (embedding+rerank amortized) for long-term TCO.
- Model preferences: open LLMs for rerank (Llama/Redwood-verified variants), vector dims 1536-4096; support quantized variants recommended.
- Routing/fallback: require local dedicated pool with automatic fallback to hosted read-only model in cross-zone failures.
